Goose at approximately (0.48, 0.50) standing on grass right of stile, white body upright, orange beak empty, orange feet walking. decision.hypothesis: The goose needs to be physically adjacent to the tennis ball for pickup to work. Right-click needs to be held (not just tapped) to walk goose to location. Will hold right mouse button at tennis ball position for a longer duration to walk goose there.
